description_en: Creates a scheduled vulnerability scanning policy that automatically sends vulnerability scanning tasks to user endpoint devices within the effective scope based on the configured cycle
description_zh: 创建一条漏洞定时扫描策略，按配置的周期自动向生效范围内的用户终端设备下发漏洞扫描任务
name: CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描
parameters.help_en: The policy name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端执行漏洞扫描
parameters.name: strategy_description

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: The policy takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: The policy takes effect only for users in specified user groups. In this case, UserGroupIds is required
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
parameters.help_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周
parameters.name: scan_frequency

parameters.help_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle, which determines the trigger cycle together with ScanFrequency. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
parameters.help_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次
parameters.name: scan_interval

parameters.help_en: The start hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 1 to 24, exclusive of the specified hour. The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_end_time

parameters.help_en: The list of exempt users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan of this policy. The list can contain up to 1000 entries. Duplicate entries are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。最多包含1000个，不允许重复
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the user groups for which the policy takes effect. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal and must not be specified when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll. The list must contain at least 1 and at most 100 entries. Duplicate entries are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupNormal时必填，取值为UserGroupAll时不允许传入。传入时至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: user_group_ids
